prompts:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Create one polished 16:9 pitch deck slide image, 1920x1080 style. Slide 5 for Sachet, Team ANKOR. White minimal editorial design, near-black navy typography, orange accent numerals and dotted curved arrows, restrained pale-grey borders. Follow reference image 1's visual language, but create a distinct new slide. No decorative icons, no orange bottom strip, no gratuitous empty space.
Title top centered: "Detection Logic", visually equivalent to 54 pt. Main definition centered beneath, equivalent to 32 pt: "Sachet links requested actions to earlier claims and shows the evidence behind each supported concern."
Content must be substantial, clean, readable and correctly spelled.
Three logic stages:
"01  Observe the claim"
"Funds are described as available for withdrawal. The opening alone may not support a warning."
"02  Identify the condition"
"A later request makes access to those funds conditional on an additional payment."
"03  Explain the concern"
"Show the exact supporting quote, identify uncertainty, and offer independent verification."
Three outcome labels with short explanations:
"Supported concern" / "Pause & verify"
"Missing decisive context" / "Ask a relevant question"
"No supported concern" / "Explain the limits"
Keep the last outcome neutral grey, never a green 'safe' verdict.
Use actual prototype evidence as two LARGE readable screenshot crops. Reference image 2 is the 'Why this needs a look' screenshot: preserve UI including exact source quote and Evidence 2; crop off top navigation remnants. Reference image 3 is the full prototype: extract only the 'What we don't know' panel, retaining its real visible text. Place each crop inside a precise light border with a small editorial heading. Do not use a whole tiny phone screenshot; enlarge the relevant panels.
Evidence quote is: "Agent: Before you can withdraw your investment profit, pay an advance tax of ₹3,000 to release the funds."
Uncertainty panel says: "Limited English pattern rules; unfamiliar wording and missing context can lead to missed concerns." "An empty concern list does not establish that an interaction is safe." "Only material supplied to this case is assessed; identity and transaction legitimacy are not verified."
Do not add any standalone line about English rules baseline or Groq/Gemini adapters. Do not add model-performance statistics, AI authorship detection, confidence percentages or extra disclaimers. Genuine screenshot panel text stays intact.
Small clean footer: left "Sachet · Team ANKOR", center "Prototype evidence · Synthetic test material", right "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2".
Layout A: Top three-stage horizontal flow with orange dotted connectors. Middle/lower two balanced side-by-side screenshot panels: left 'Evidence behind the concern', right 'Uncertainty stays visible'. Bottom compact three-column outcomes row. Give screenshots about 45% of total canvas height. Align on an exact editorial grid.
